s0125: In 2026 Acriol remains dominant in the category, holding a **66–71%** sales share. In February, a digital budget increase to **RUB 1.64M** coincided with higher sales vs January, but later months show no direct month-to-month link: sales peaked in March on lower spend. In April–June, the digital budget cut **from RUB 1.43M to 0.72M** came with a drop in sales share **from 71% to 66%**. This does not prove a direct media effect, but it signals a risk that the brand weakens when advertising support is cut.
